stem: Which of the following has resulted from the increased use of computers in the workplace?

options.label: F
options.text: Corporate use of vertical integration has increased.

options.label: G
options.text: Employees are required to sign Internet-usage agreements.

options.label: H
options.text: Unions demand that a forty-hour workweek be enforced.

options.label: J
options.text: The number of employees that are granted off-site access has decreased.
